messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Levothyroxine is a man-made form of thyroxine (T4), one of the hormones your thyroid gland normally produces.
Levothyroxine belongs to a class of medications called hormones.
Levothyroxine works by replacing thyroid hormone that your body is not making enough of.
Levothyroxine is used in adults and children, including newborn babies, to:
treat hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid - a condition where the thyroid gland does not produce enough thyroid hormone).
Levothyroxine replaces the missing hormone whether the condition was present from birth or developed later.
It replaces the missing hormone whether the problem starts in the thyroid gland itself or in the pituitary gland or hypothalamus.
lower the level of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) in the blood in people being treated for a certain type of thyroid cancer, alongside surgery and radioactive iodine therapy.
Levothyroxine injection is used in adults to treat myxedema coma.
Myxedema coma is a rare and life-threatening complication.
Myxedema coma is a complication of a severely underactive thyroid.
Triplet: ["myxedema coma", "is complication of", "severely underactive thyroid"]

The relation 'is complication of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is a complication of the condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
B. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
E. 'has severity': The medical condition or effect specified by the subject has the severity specified by the object entity.
